name: courtneyr.dev
description: Brand design system for Courtney Robertson — Senior Open Source Developer Advocate at GoDaddy, WordPress educator, IndieWeb contributor. Personal site with the voice of a patient teacher and the visual confidence of a hand-pasted zine. WordPress + IndieWeb + AA contrast.
principles: Decoration in margins, calm in measure.
Zine treatment for landing pages, marketing, hero sections.
Calm-with-zine-accents for blog posts, stream/feed, long-form reading.
Tables stay un-rotated for scan readability.
Wordmark is all-paths SVG — no font dependency.

surface.texture: subtle horizontal fiber, ~1.2% opacity at 2-3px stripes; halftone overlay on hero surfaces

glaucous.description: Background only — fails AA on cream as text

sky-blue.description: Soft signature, accent block 1, table thead

blue-green.description: Secondary teal, link hover, nested bullets

cerulean.description: Muted text, links, callout bg, figcaption

prussian-blue.description: Reserved deep ink, dark-mode soft surface

typography.notes: Four-font system. Rock Salt is the handwritten display font (used in the wordmark and for hero displays); Barlow is the body sans for paragraphs and UI; Roboto Slab is the warm slab serif for headings, eyebrows, blockquote; system mono for code. Rock Salt is intentionally dense and marker-like — display only, never used for body or long paragraphs.

role-guidance.wordmark: Rock Salt, lowercase. Entire 'courtneyr.dev' renders in Rock Salt including the period. All-paths SVG, no font dependency at runtime (see brand/wordmark.svg).
role-guidance.hero-display: Rock Salt, regular weight, kept short (under 6 words). For longer hero titles, use the .cr-hero__title (Roboto Slab) treatment instead.
role-guidance.hero-title: Roboto Slab, weight 800–900, tight leading. The accent voice for hero sections that don't use Rock Salt.
role-guidance.section-h2: Roboto Slab, weight 800. Warm and assertive without competing with Rock Salt.
role-guidance.stream-title: Roboto Slab, weight 700. The slab serif makes post titles feel substantial next to the chip and metadata.
role-guidance.eyebrow: Roboto Slab, weight 700, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.12em, ut-orange. Block-level (not inline-block).
role-guidance.body: Barlow, weight 400–500. Excellent at body sizes. Use weight 500 for UI labels.
role-guidance.meta: Barlow, weight 600, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.08em. Used on chips, timestamps, taxonomy labels.
role-guidance.quote: Roboto Slab italic, weight 400. Default <blockquote> and .cr-pull-quote.
role-guidance.mono: system mono. Code samples, kbd, samp, var.

motion.notes: All non-essential motion gated behind @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference). The reduced-motion block in tokens.css zeroes out all transitions and animations.

texture.fiber: subtle horizontal lines, ~1.2% opacity at 2-3px stripes, applied to body background
texture.halftone: radial-gradient dot overlay, ~18% opacity, 6px grid; used on hero surfaces only

components.cr-eyebrow: Block-level kicker above a heading (display:block, NOT inline-block)
components.cr-pull-quote: Big Roboto Slab quote block, marker bar above and below
components.cr-marker-bar: UT Orange marker stripe section divider (--short modifier)
components.cr-accent-block: Generic accent block (--1 sky-blue, --2 periwinkle, --3 light-orange)
components.cr-chip: Post-type taxonomy chip — masking-tape style with per-type color

nonNegotiables: <dfn> has no underline (looks like a link otherwise)
figcaption color is cerulean, NOT glaucous (3.5:1 fails AA on cream)
surface is printer ivory (#fbfaf5), NOT warm cream
wordmark renders as all-paths SVG with no font dependency
Rock Salt is display-only, never used for body text
AA contrast is the floor for all token combinations
tables stay un-rotated for scan readability

wordmark.notes: All glyphs of 'courtneyr.dev' rendered as SVG paths from Rock Salt. Works even if Rock Salt fails to load.

deprecated.shape-layering: Removed in v2.0. The signature soft-circle-behind-image + floating-badge pattern from v1.x is gone. Zine vocabulary (hard shadows, slight rotation, halftone, masking-tape labels) handles all depth in v2.0.
